title: Domain-Aware Hybrid Quantum Learning via Correlation-Guided Circuit Design for Crime Pattern Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2604.07389v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Crime pattern analysis is critical for law enforcement and predictive policing, yet the surge in criminal activities from rapid urbanization creates high-dimensional, imbalanced datasets that challenge traditional classification methods. This study presents a quantum-classical comparison framework for crime analytics, evaluating four computational paradigms: quantum models, classical baseline machine learning models, and two hybrid quantum-classical architectures. Using 16-year crime statistics, we systematically assess classification performance and computational efficiency under rigorous cross-validation methods. Experimental results show that quantum-inspired approaches, particularly QAOA, achieve up to 84.6% accuracy, while requiring fewer trainable parameters than classical baselines, suggesting practical advantages for memory-constrained edge deployment. translated_title: 基于相关性引导电路设计的领域感知混合量子学习用于犯罪模式分析
translated_abstract: 犯罪模式分析对执法和预测性警务至关重要，然而快速城市化带来的犯罪活动激增产生了高维、不平衡的数据集，这对传统分类方法构成了挑战。本研究提出了一种用于犯罪分析的量子-经典比较框架，评估了四种计算范式：量子模型、经典基线机器学习模型以及两种混合量子-经典架构。利用16年的犯罪统计数据，我们在严格的交叉验证方法下系统评估了分类性能和计算效率。实验结果表明，量子启发方法（特别是QAOA）实现了高达84.6%的准确率，同时所需的可训练参数比经典基线更少，这表明其在内存受限的边缘部署方面具有实际优势。所提出的相关性感知电路设计展示了……的潜力（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究提出一种基于相关性引导电路设计的领域感知混合量子-经典学习框架用于犯罪模式分析，其中QAOA方法以更少的可训练参数实现了高达84.6%的准确率，在内存受限的边缘部署场景中展现出实际优势。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a domain-aware hybrid quantum-classical learning framework with correlation-guided circuit design for crime pattern analytics, where QAOA achieves up to 84.6% accuracy with fewer trainable parameters, offering practical advantages for memory-constrained edge deployment.
